description: Registry of tasks HAL may execute autonomously without explicit per-task approval. Each entry defines scope, frequency, and escalation rules. Results are batched and reported to Joe weekly.
global_constraints: NEVER send messages to external people without Alfred approval
NEVER spend more than $2.00 per autonomous run
NEVER make schema changes to databases or APIs
ALWAYS write results to the designated output path
ALWAYS post completion summary via hal-slack-notify.sh

tasks.name: Overnight Code Review
tasks.description: Review recent commits to Joe's repos for quality issues, security concerns, and improvement opportunities
can_decide: Which style issues to flag vs. ignore
Whether a pattern is an anti-pattern
must_escalate: Suggested changes to auth or payment code
If review finds breaking changes in main branch

tasks.name: Idea Vetting & Scoring
tasks.description: Score and summarize new ideas in the kanban ideas column. Filter noise, surface top 3 worth Joe's attention.
can_decide: Scoring criteria weights (market size, effort, fit)
Whether an idea is a duplicate of an existing project
Which ideas to archive as low-signal
must_escalate: Ideas that require Joe's personal network or active client relationships
Ideas that directly compete with existing Joe products

tasks.name: Market Signal Vetting
tasks.description: Fetch and score crypto/stock signals from Market Signal Lab. Filter low-confidence signals, summarize top picks with rationale.
must_escalate: Signals suggesting position sizes > 10% of portfolio
Contradictory signals on same asset (buy + sell)
Data source errors or API failures lasting >2h

tasks.name: Weekly Alfred-HAL Collaboration Sync
tasks.description: Weekly review of Alfred↔HAL handoff quality, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities. Produces a short summary + 1–3 concrete improvements for next week.
can_decide: Which metrics to include in the report
Whether to flag a pattern as systemic vs. one-off
must_escalate: Recommendations that require Joe approval (policy, budget, external changes)
If collab health score drops below 60% two weeks in a row
